about_the_game:
Run for your life! There’s a soulless killing machine chasing you! Only one of you can survive, so act quick. Use missiles, landmines, shockwaves, traps, and other kinds of weapons to ensure your survival!

Trouble Dash is a combat racing platformer where you and your friends speed through an obstacle course filled with weapons and interactive environment elements. You can choose from 3 upgradable character types that are strong against different types of collectables and have different performance characteristics.

Play locally against AI or hop online to show other people what you’re made of. You can choose to play co-op mode in teams, or play free-for-all.

Key Features

  • Cut-throat combat racing featuring up to 8 players!

  • Variety of weapons and other collectables to show them who’s boss

  • Outrun your demise and be the one to survive!

  • Customize your appearance and create your own unique style

  • Upgrade and tune your character for different styles of gameplay

  • Single player

  • Online and local multiplayer

  • Co-op and free-for-all modes

  • Numerous tracks carefully designed with game mechanics in mind

  • Feature rich level editor and level sharing

  • Plenty of achievements

Powerful Level Editor

Don’t limit yourself to obstacles with basic shapes - the level editor is designed to allow you to create any kinds of obstacles you want. Don’t want to do that? No worries, there still are plenty of obstacle presets for you to choose from!

short_description: Escape doom as you sabotage your friends in this cut-throat combat racing platformer! Employ lethal weapons, upgrade your character, and spice up the race by choosing from three character classes with different characteristics. Play single player or online multiplayer in free-for-all or co-op mode.
